canonical_project: EGIS Asset Management AI Data Center (Myeongji-Noksan National Industrial Complex)
notes: MOU signed 17 Jun 2025 between Busan city and EGIS Asset Management to invest KRW 1.8 trillion to build two large AI-specialized data centers (10-story and 13-story buildings) at the Myeongji-Noksan National Industrial Complex (Noksan-dong, Gangseo-gu); 300+ direct jobs and ~7,570 total employment effect expected; groundbreaking targeted 2026. ~105 MW reported by trade blogs (unverified); capacity not confirmed by official sources.
